decisions.reason: The source criticizes the Hero V and second V hierarchy and ends further revisions, but it does not change or cancel the established Hero V–É accent peak-alignment rule.
The source does not alter the rule that both Vs share the baseline established by the E and L; ending revisions does not entail a new baseline specification.
Removing the second V hierarchy requirement because the project ended does not remove the second V from the existing artwork or alter the selected Satin Reflection finish and gold distribution.
The project-ending decision and request for editable working files do not modify the accepted formats for viewable iteration proofs.
